messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body. Retain the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a rooftop, swaying and turning while placing her hands on her hips and raising one arm near her head.","camera":"Medium full-body shot from behind at a low angle, with slight forward movement and subtle reframing as she turns.","clothing":"Pink-and-white gingham sleeveless top, white off-shoulder sleeves, black shorts, and blue sneakers.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Dark hair pulled back into a high ponytail with a small hair tie.","identity":"A 3D animated woman with dark skin and a slim build, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"A stylized city rooftop at dusk, with tall buildings, neon signs, a construction crane, and a wet reflective tiled floor."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output appears visually identical to the source across the sampled frames. The character's dark skin tone, black ponytail, clothing, pose, rooftop scene, and camera movement are preserved, but no visible facial identity change toward the reference person can be confirmed.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's facial identity and skin tone to match the reference photo, while retaining hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: The face is mostly shown from behind or in profile, so any subtle facial identity change cannot be reliably judged.
